papers.title_en: Cohen-Macaulay truncated path and Nakayama algebras
papers.evidence: 用普通箭图刻画截断路代数与Nakayama代数中的Cohen-Macaulay代数
papers.tldr: 论文研究有限维代数中 Auslander–Reiten 意义下的 Cohen–Macaulay 代数，聚焦截断路径代数与 Nakayama 代数两类。作者用普通箭图刻画前者的 CM 性质，并证明连通 CM 截断路径代数由 Λ 或其对偶 D(Λ) 给出双化模。对 Nakayama 代数，证明每个 CM 代数均为 Iwanaga–Gorenstein，因而 Λ 总给出双化模；最终表明这两类中不存在非平凡 CM 代数。
papers.abstract_en: This paper characterizes Cohen-Macaulay algebras in the sense of Auslander and Reiten [Progr. Math. 95(1991)] within the following two classes of finite dimensional algebras: (i) truncated path algebras and (ii) Nakayama algebras. For the former, our characterization in terms of ordinary quivers shows that if a Cohen-Macaulay truncated path algebra $Λ$ is connected, then $Λ$ or $D(Λ)$ gives a dualizing module, where $D$ denotes the standard duality. For the latter, we show that every Cohen-Macaulay Nakayama algebra $Λ$ is Iwanaga-Gorenstein. In particular, $Λ$ always gives a dualizing module. Consequently, there is no non-trivial Cohen-Macaulay algebra among truncated path and Nakayama algebras.

papers.title_en: Representation Type and Schurian Finiteness of Tits Algebras
papers.evidence: 用界箭图与不可分解模刻画Tits代数的表示型
papers.tldr: 本文研究有限中心实超平面配置的Tits代数在代数闭域上的表示类型与Schurian有限性。作者结合Saliola界箭图表示、显式模构造、凸子箭图、本质化与删除方法进行分类。结果表明：至多两个超平面时表示有限，三个时驯服，至少四个时野；Schurian有限当且仅当至多两个超平面。该分类适用于任意特征，并给出平面情形全部十一个不可分解模及自由代数模的满精确嵌入。
papers.abstract_en: We determine the representation type and Schurian finiteness of the Tits algebra of a finite central real hyperplane arrangement over an algebraically closed field. The algebra is representation-finite when the arrangement has at most two hyperplanes, tame when it has three, and wild when it has at least four. Moreover, it is Schurian-finite if and only if the arrangement has at most two hyperplanes. Both classifications hold over algebraically closed fields of arbitrary characteristic. The proof combines Saliola's bound-quiver presentation with explicit module constructions, convex subquivers, essentialization, and deletion. In the $\mathbb{R}^2$ case, we describe all eleven indecomposable modules for two lines and construct a full exact embedding of modules over a free algebra for at least four lines.

papers.evidence: 箭图的完备路径代数、均匀理想与不可分解模
papers.tldr: 本文研究路余代数的对偶代数（即完全路径代数）何时没有非零一致右理想，推广了作者先前关于无零 hollow 因子的不可分解模的工作。通过用箭图 Q 的顶点与可达性刻画代数结构，证明该性质成立当且仅当 Q 的每个顶点都能到达某个至少发出两条不同箭头的顶点。等价地，右正则模的内射包 E(R) 是超可分解的；路余代数作为其对偶代数的左模也没有非零 hollow 因子模。这给出了完全路径代数超可分解性的箭图判据。
papers.abstract_en: Generalizing the setting of the second author's work on indecomposable modules without nonzero hollow factors, we characterize quivers $Q$ for which the dual algebra $R$ of the path coalgebra of $Q$, equivalently the complete path algebra, has no nonzero uniform right ideals: this happens exactly when every vertex of $Q$ can reach a vertex emitting at least two distinct arrows. Equivalently, the injective hull $E(R)$ of the right regular module is superdecomposable. These conditions are also equivalent to the path coalgebra having no nonzero hollow factor modules as a left module over its dual algebra.

papers.title_en: A subcategory with remarkable homological properties via actions of tensor categories
papers.evidence: 构造对Auslander-Reiten平移封闭并计算有限生成维数的子范畴
papers.tldr: 本文在有限维代数模范畴 M 上引入有限张量范畴 C 的作用，构造子范畴 PM。借助函子范畴视角，将 PM 刻画为投射的 C-模函子，并证明 C-等变 Auslander-Solberg 对应。该子范畴具有生成与余生成、函子有限、对 Auslander-Reiten 平移封闭及计算有限维数等性质。对张量积代数与 1-Iwanaga-Gorenstein 代数给出应用，后者中 PM 恰为 τ-局部自由模子范畴。
papers.abstract_en: By equipping the category $\mathcal{M}$ of modules over a finite dimensional algebra with the action of a finite tensor category $\mathcal{C}$, we introduce a subcategory $\mathcal{PM}$ satisfying numerous remarkable properties: it is generating and cogenerating, functorially finite, closed under Auslander--Reiten translations (i.e. precluster tilting), and it computes the finitistic dimension. Through a functor category perspective, $\mathcal{PM}$ is identified with the $\mathcal{C}$-module functors that are projective, and we also prove a $\mathcal{C}$-equivariant version of the Auslander(--Solberg) correspondence. As examples, we show that $\mathcal{PM}$ contains only finitely many indecomposable modules for some tensor product algebras. For some family of 1-Iwanaga--Gorenstein algebras introduced by Geiss--Leclerc--Schröer, we show that $\mathcal{PM}$ is exactly the subcategory of $τ$-locally free modules.

papers.title_en: A Krause-type recollement for Q-shaped derived categories
papers.evidence: 构造Q形导出范畴的recollement结构
papers.tldr: 论文研究 Q 形导出范畴的 Krause 型粘连结构。作者在交换诺特遗传环及具 Serre 函子、强收缩性质与幂零伪根的 Q 上，用完备遗传余挠对构造 K_Q(A Inj) 由精确对象子范畴 K_ac^Q(A Inj) 与 D_Q(A) 给出的 recollement，且不要求 A 诺特。若 A 左诺特，则两个范畴由有限生成茎模的特殊预包络紧生成，并给出紧对象与局部化左伴随的幂等完备关系。该结果推广了 Krause 与 Liu 的工作。
papers.abstract_en: Let k be a commutative noetherian hereditary ring and let Q be a small, Hom-finite, locally bounded k-linear category admitting a Serre functor and satisfying the strong retraction property, with nilpotent pseudo-radical. For every k-algebra A, we construct a recollement of the Q-shaped homo?topy category KQ(A Inj) of objectwise injective Q-shaped modules by its full subcategory Kac Q (A Inj) of exact objects and the Q-shaped derived category DQ(A). The construction uses complete hereditary cotorsion pairs and does not require A to be noetherian. If A is left noetherian, both KQ(A Inj) and Kac Q (A Inj) are compactly generated by special preenvelopes of finitely generat?ed stalk modules. We identify (Kac Q (A Inj))c with the idempotent completion of (KQ(A Inj))c/LI ((DQ(A))c ), where LI is the fully faithful left adjoint of the localization. This paper builds on and generalizes works of Krause and Liu

papers.evidence: n-正合与n-角化范畴的理想商，且与丛倾斜相容
papers.tldr: 本文把可移除子范畴的概念推广到 n-exact 范畴，并研究用投射-内射子范畴作理想商时，商范畴能否继承原有的 n-exact 结构。作者证明这种继承恰好等价于该子范畴可移除，同时分析 Frobenius 情形：商范畴仍为 Frobenius，且相应稳定 (n+2)-angulated 范畴彼此等价。文中进一步给出投射-内射子范畴可移除的一个充分条件，并说明理想商构造与 cluster tilting 相容。最后将该构造用于 Geigle–Lenzing 射影平面上 ACM 丛的 2-cluster tilting 子范畴，分别得到自然与相对 2-exact 结构下的商。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we extend the notion of a removable subcategory to $n$-exact categories, and prove that an ideal quotient by a subcategory of projective-injectives inherits an $n$-exact structure from the original category if and only if the subcategory is removable. In the Frobenius case, the quotient remains Frobenius, and the stable $(n+2)$-angulated categories are equivalent. We give a sufficient condition for a subcategory of projective-injectives to be removable. We also show that the ideal quotient construction is compatible with cluster tilting. Finally, we apply the construction to $2$-cluster tilting subcategories of the category of ACM bundles on a Geigle--Lenzing projective plane, obtaining quotients for both natural and relative $2$-exact structures.

papers.title_en: A Gordon--Green-type result for Gorenstein-projective modules
papers.evidence: 分级Artin代数上Gorenstein-投射模的Gordon-Green型定理
papers.tldr: 在Z-分次Artin代数且Iwanaga-Gorenstein的设定下，研究Gorenstein-投射模的有限性刻画。通过分次Gorenstein-投射模与不可分解模长度有界性建立等价关系。证明Λ为CM-finite当且仅当可分次Gorenstein-投射模范畴具有有限型，也当且仅当不可分解可分次Gorenstein-投射模长度有界。进一步在CM-finite时所有Gorenstein-投射模均可分次，给出Gordon-Green定理的Gorenstein-投射类比。
papers.abstract_en: Let \(Λ\) be a \(\Z\)-graded Artin algebra which is Iwanaga--Gorenstein. We prove that \(Λ\) is CM-finite if and only if the category of gradable Gorenstein-projective modules has finite type, and if and only if the lengths of the indecomposable gradable Gorenstein-projective modules are bounded. Moreover, if \(Λ\) is CM-finite, then every Gorenstein-projective \(Λ\)-module is gradable. These results provide Gorenstein-projective analogues of the corresponding theorems of Gordon--Green for graded Artin algebras of finite representation type.

papers.title_en: Linear Laurent phenomenon algebras are of finite type
papers.evidence: 推广簇代数并证明有限型猜想
papers.tldr: Laurent现象代数用不可约交换多项式推广丛代数，但其线性种子情形是否有限型此前仅有图来源的特例。本文在任意唯一分解整环上构造上代数中一个非零元素，使其被所有丛变量整除。再在初始Laurent环中比较非初始丛变量与该元素的素因子，从而约束丛变量类数。由此证明Lam–Pylyavskyy猜想：具线性种子的Laurent现象代数均为有限型。
papers.abstract_en: Laurent phenomenon algebras generalise cluster algebras by allowing irreducible exchange polynomials in place of binomials. Lam and Pylyavskyy proved finite type for those arising from graphs and conjectured that the same holds for every Laurent phenomenon algebra admitting a linear seed. We prove this conjecture over an arbitrary unique factorisation domain. Our proof constructs a nonzero element of the upper algebra divisible by every cluster variable. Comparing noninitial cluster variables with the prime factors of this element in the initial Laurent ring bounds the number of cluster variable classes and yields a finite normalised mutation pattern.

papers.title_en: Minimal presentations of finite-dimensional representations of pseudocompact algebras
papers.authors: Christof Geiss, Carolin Hartung, Daniel Labardini-Fragoso, Jan Schröer
papers.evidence: 伪紧代数有限维模与最小呈现
papers.tldr: 论文研究基本伪紧代数上有限维模的极小表现问题。作者给出极小投射表现与极小离散内射表现的一般公式，并证明表示论g-vector与DWZ-g-vector一致。该结果推广了Derksen-Weyman-Zelevinsky对有限维Jacobian代数的描述，去掉有限性假设并允许任意特征域。它为更广泛代数上的模表现和g-vector计算提供了统一框架。
papers.abstract_en: We give a general formula for minimal projective presentations and for minimal discrete-injective presentations of finite-dimensional modules over basic pseudocompact algebras. We also show that the representation-theoretic g-vector of a module coincides with its DWZ-g-vector. These results generalize the description that Derksen, Weyman and Zelevinsky gave of minimal projective presentations for modules over certain finite-dimensional Jacobian algebras. In particular, we can drop their finiteness assumption, and we may work over fields of arbitrary characteristic.

papers.evidence: 簇代数中箭图变异环的指标
papers.tldr: 受三维-三维对应启发，本文为quiver的mutation loop和整数g≥0引入指标I_g^φ，用于刻画变异环的代数与几何信息。作者在特定条件下证明该指标取整数值，把Gang--Kim--Yoon关于三维流形的整性猜想推广到cluster algebra的更广框架。该指标还可解释为(1+1)维TQFT的亏格g配分函数。文章给出周期1的显式计算，并在广义Kronecker quiver情形下将全亏格生成函数表示为多项式之比。
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the 3d-3d correspondence, we introduce an index $\mathcal{I}_g^φ$ for a mutation loop $φ$ of a quiver and an integer $g \geq 0$. We prove its integrality $\mathcal{I}_g^φ\in \mathbb{Z}$ under certain conditions, which extends the integrality conjecture of Gang--Kim--Yoon for $3$-manifolds to the broader framework of mutation loops in cluster algebras. Our index also has an interpretation as the genus-$g$ partition function of a $(1+1)$-dimensional TQFT. We provide explicit computations for mutation loops of period one. In particular, in the case of the generalized Kronecker quivers, we give an explicit formula expressing the generating function of the indices for all genera $g$ as a ratio of polynomials. Altogether, we provide a new insight to the interplay between the geometry of $3$-manifolds and cluster algebra.

papers.title_en: Generalized Cluster Algebra Homomorphisms Induced by Cluster Tube Embeddings
papers.evidence: 簇管嵌入诱导的簇代数同态
papers.tldr: 论文研究簇管嵌入诱导的广义簇代数同态。作者在Zhou-Zhu构造中引入参数z，定义簇管上的加权簇特征，建立不可分解刚性对象与簇变量的一一对应；再利用正则模乘法公式与Ding-Xiao-Xu差分性质，证明非齐次簇管嵌入在z↦X_δ下给出到普通仿射簇代数的单同态，并将X_δ解释为theta函数。
papers.abstract_en: We relate multiplication formulas for regular modules in coefficient-free acyclic affine cluster algebras with skew-symmetric exchange matrices to the imaginary exchange relations of Reading-Stella. Introducing a parameter $z$ into the construction of Zhou-Zhu, we define a weighted cluster character on cluster tubes that satisfies generalized exchange relations of type $C_{n-1}$ and yields a bijection between indecomposable rigid objects and cluster variables. Using the multiplication formulas and difference property of Ding-Xiao-Xu, we show that non-homogeneous tube embeddings induce injective homomorphisms into ordinary affine cluster algebras under $z\mapsto X_δ$. Comparison with Reading-Stella's relations identifies $X_δ$ with the corresponding theta function, giving a representation-theoretic interpretation of the generalized exchange parameter.

papers.title_en: Point Modules of Non-Connected Graded Algebras
papers.evidence: 研究路径代数分次商的点模
papers.tldr: 为把 Artin-Tate-Van den Bergh 的齐次坐标环方法推广到扭曲分次 Calabi-Yau 代数，本文转向非连通分次代数并系统研究其点模。作者对路径代数的分次商引入弱点模与强点模，给出相应模叠的显式计算，并比较它们与连通分次情形经典点概型之间的联系。作为应用，文章具体分析若干二维和三维扭曲 Calabi-Yau 代数的点叠结构；这些结果拓展了 ATV 框架在非连通情形的适用性，并为非交换射影几何提供基础工具。
papers.abstract_en: As part of a program to extend the homogeneous coordinate ring techniques of Artin-Tate-Van den Bergh to twisted graded Calabi-Yau (tCY) algebras, we initiate the study of point modules of non-connected graded algebras. We define weak and strong point modules of graded quotients of path algebras and compute their respective moduli stacks. We describe the relation between these point stacks and the classical point schemes in the connected graded setting, and we analyze the point stacks of several 2 and 3-dimensional tCY algebras.

papers.title_en: Derivation based noncommutative geometry of quiver path algebras
papers.evidence: 箭图路代数的导子微分结构
papers.tldr: 本文研究箭图路径代数的非交换几何：先选取导子Lie代数并据此构造微分calculus，再分析其性质与箭图结构的联系。作者引入分离箭图，证明微分形式模为投射双模等价于该分离条件。对这类箭图可建立双模联络与双模形式，并给出一类可构造Levi-Civita联络的箭图。该框架揭示箭图结构对非交换微分几何的决定作用，为路径代数上的联络与度量研究提供新途径。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study derivation based noncommutative geometry of path algebras arising from quivers by identifying a Lie algebra of derivations from which a differential calculus is constructed. We show that properties of the differential calculus are intimately connected with the structure of the quiver. In particular, by introducing the notion of a separating quiver, we find a condition on the quiver which is equivalent to the module of differential forms being a projective bimodule. For such quivers, one can construct bimodule connections, as well as bimodule forms which serve as noncommutative analogues of the Riemannian metric. As an illustration of the above concepts, we present a class of quivers for which one can construct Levi-Civita connections, i.e. torsion free connections compatible with a bimodule form.

papers.title_en: Weight structures and t-structures on the triangulated category generated by a $\mathbb{P}$-object
papers.evidence: 分类三角范畴上的权结构与t-结构
papers.tldr: 本文研究由 P^n[k]-对象生成的三角范畴，分类其权重结构与 t-结构。作者在 Huybrechts–Thomas 的 P-对象框架下，结合 Krug 的定义处理这类广义球状对象。当 n=1 时，结果退化为 Holm–Jorgensen–Yang 关于球状对象生成范畴的已知分类。文中还计算了该范畴的 Koszul 对偶模型，为高维球状对象情形提供统一视角。
papers.abstract_en: $\mathbb{P}$-objects were introduced by Huybrechts and Thomas as a generalization of spherical objects. We classify the weight structures and t-structures on the triangulated category generated by a $\mathbb{P}^n[k]$-object in the sense of Krug. For $n=1$, this recovers the classification of weight structures and t-structures on the triangulated category generated by a spherical object due to Holm, Jorgensen and Yang. We also compute the Koszul-dual model of the triangulated category generated by a $\mathbb{P}^n[k]$-object.

papers.authors: Azat M. Gainutdinov, Jesper Lykke Jacobsen, Yueheng Li
papers.evidence: 图代数的胞腔结构与表示论
papers.tldr: 论文为Kuperberg的A2网图引入图代数K_L，证明它与U_q(sl3)张量表示空间的自同态代数满足Schur-Weyl对偶，从而成为Temperley-Lieb代数的A2类比。作者构造显式胞腔结构，以网图基为胞腔基，并用支配格路径递归参数化胞腔模。进一步确定局部生成元，给出不变量理论第一、第二基本定理的网图表述；还发现辫群像加局部幂等元仍不能生成K_L，需补充一个局部生成元。最后给出张量空间的双模分解，得到形式或一般q下的全部不可约K_L模。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a diagram algebra $\mathcal{K}_L$ based on Kuperberg's $A_2$-webs and prove a Schur--Weyl duality $\mathcal{K}_L \cong \operatorname{End}_{U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)}((V^+ \oplus V^-)^{\otimes L})$, where $V^\pm$ are the fundamental representations of $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)$. Thus, $\mathcal{K}_L$ is a natural $A_2$ analogue of the Temperley--Lieb algebra. We construct an explicit cellular structure for $\mathcal{K}_L$, with the web basis as its cellular basis and cell modules indexed by dominant $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)$-weights. The bases of these modules are parametrized by dominant lattice paths via a recursive growth algorithm. Using this structure, we determine local generators of $\mathcal{K}_L$ and establish web formulations of the first and second fundamental theorems of invariant theory. In particular, we show that the braid-group image, augmented by local idempotents, does not generate $\mathcal{K}_L$, and identify an additional local generator. Finally, we derive a bimodule decomposition of $(V^+ \oplus V^-)^{\otimes L}$, yielding a complete set of irreducible $\mathcal{K}_L$-modules for formal or generic $q$.

papers.evidence: 三角范畴的recollement与导出范畴
papers.tldr: 论文研究弱逼近性（weak approximability）能否沿由单一对象紧生成的三角范畴的recollement粘合。作者以recollement的分层结构为框架，考察局部弱逼近性向整体传递的条件。关键结果给出粘合判据，并将其应用于拟紧拟分离代数空间上具有拟凝聚上同调与指定支撑的复形导出范畴。该工作为派生范畴中的逼近性质提供统一粘合视角。
papers.abstract_en: We study whether weak approximability glues along recollements of triangulated categories that are compactly generated by a single object. This is applied to derived categories of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology and prescribed support for quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces.

papers.title_en: Series of Fano quiver moduli from extended Dynkin quivers
papers.evidence: 由扩展Dynkin箭图构造箭图模空间
papers.tldr: 为构造Picard秩受限且维数可任意增大的Fano簇系列，本文从小的扩展Dynkin quiver出发研究其quiver模空间。作者给出这些Fano簇的显式几何描述，证明它们均可平坦映射到射影空间且一般纤维为射影直线之积。进一步得到所有Betti数的闭公式，并用上同调Hall代数作用解释该公式。该工作提供了高维Fano簇的可计算系列与统一上同调框架。
papers.abstract_en: Associated to small extended Dynkin quivers, we construct series of Fano varieties of fixed Picard rank at most five and arbitrary even dimension, which admit a very explicit description of their geometry. For example, they all admit a flat morphism to a projective space, whose general fiber is a product of projective lines. We also give a closed formula for all Betti numbers, and interpret this formula in terms of an action of a cohomological Hall algebra on the cohomology of all the varieties in a series.
